_comment: Datebook's own Google OAuth client — the reason a user only has to press
SYNC WITH GOOGLE CALENDAR instead of registering a Cloud project.
Fill client_id and client_secret in once, from a Desktop app OAuth client in
the Datebook Cloud project, and commit them. See docs/google-setup.md for
the console steps and the verification Google requires before strangers can
use it without a warning screen.
A client shipped inside a desktop app is not a secret: anyone can read it
out of the package, which RFC 8252 s8.5 says to expect. PKCE, not this
string, is what stops a stolen authorization code being redeemed.
Left empty, Datebook simply has no Google integration, and bin/gcal says so
instead of half-working. A user can still put their own client in
